contribution.value: RS330 succeeded first-pass with DWF 0.1.73, closing only bounded Foundation cross-SDK GREEN and readying T1 Verification. RS331 activates that exact Verification leaf and installs a separate Math-owned C# auditor. The auditor checks both durable reports and the RS329 compiled rehearsal, original Foundation public identity, one-leaf package graph, preserved SDK 10/net10/C#14 baseline, blocked migration gate, thirteen unqualified semantics and ten absent physical archive closures. It refuses three tampered in-memory evidence cases and hashes original files before and after. Replaying the prior isolated dual-SDK source contract is the narrow fragile validation, not a new published package or full Math migration. No parent closure, new language syntax, public release, SDK promotion or sibling mutation is implied.
